Q: phpmyadmin: is there any point using dbconfig-common in installation? A:

It's useful when you want to switch from cookie. Also, your database probably has no password so you can access the tables w/o a password. When in doubt, edit manually. Your mileage will improve.

Q: A problem occurred evaluating project ':react-native-gesture-handler'. > A problem occurred starting process 'command 'node'' error A:

That is because Gradle can not find the node.

On macOS the Android studio opened can't inherit the Path. If node works in the terminal close Andriod Studio and start it from the terminal.

In the Terminal type:

open -a "Android Studio"

Or else you can also use:

open -a /Applications/Android\ Studio.app

And after this, don't forget to rebuild the project.

Q: Can a function be one of kwargs in Python partial? A:

Since python 3.14, you can use functools.Placeholder

>>> g = partial(B, alpha, Placeholder, 2)
>>> g(5)
12

and omit the need to use kwargs on everything.

Q: ERROR: column is of type uuid but expression is of type character varying A:

The error "ERROR: column is of type uuid but expression is of type character varying" typically occurs when a column in a database is defined as a UUID type but is being used in a way that requires a character varying type. This can happen when trying to insert or update a column that is expected to hold a UUID but is instead being treated as a string. To resolve this issue, you can use the following methods:

  • Use the CAST() function: In PostgreSQL, you can use the CAST() function to convert the UUID value to a string type before inserting it into the database. This ensures that the database can perform the comparison correctly.

  • Custom Converter in JPA: You can also use the @Converter annotation in JPA to define a custom converter for the UUID object and varchar column. This converter facilitates the seamless conversion between UUID objects and their string representations in the database.

  • Update Connection Properties: If you're using Spark to write to PostgreSQL, you may need to modify the connection properties to allow Spark to insert a string that represents a UUID into a column defined as UUID in PostgreSQL. Setting the property for stringtype to unspecified enables Spark to treat the string values as UUIDs during insertion.
    By following these steps, you should be able to resolve the error and successfully insert or update your data in the database.
